How to test: Keep the original file. Use Pass, Fail or Not applicable with a reason. Not tested is not a pass.

Check: Keep an untouched source and define the handoff
How to test: Work on a copy. Record the sheet, revision, source app, destination app and operating-system versions. Agree which outputs the recipient needs before testing.
What to record: Source filename and revision; app versions; reviewer; required deliverables.

How to test: Calibrate a known dimension, then check a different labeled span in the other direction. Repeat for pages or details with different scales. Agree the acceptable tolerance for this project.
What to record: Reference lengths, measured lengths, units and agreed tolerance; any scan distortion.

How to test: Compare representative lengths, net areas, exclusions and counts with the source record. Check subjects, units, rounding and page references. Do not assume that custom columns, formulas or toolsets transfer.
What to record: Expected and actual quantities; missing fields; any values or workflows rebuilt manually.

How to test: Save a separate PDF, close it and reopen it. Inspect notes, callouts, measurement labels and any required properties in the recipient’s actual viewer. Check whether items remain editable when editing is required.
What to record: Viewer and version; appearance, text and editability; any flattened or missing information.

Check: Compare the CSV and PDF handoff
How to test: Export the reviewed worksheet and open it in the intended spreadsheet or PDF viewer. Reconcile subjects, units, counts and totals against the saved drawing. Confirm that downstream pricing uses the intended units.
What to record: Export filenames; worksheet totals; downstream units; reviewer’s discrepancies.

Check: Test document controls and project requirements
How to test: Check forms, signatures, permissions, links and revision procedures that the project actually needs. Test a typical large drawing set on the intended computer. Treat Studio access as a separate requirement.
What to record: Required features tested; file size and page count; observed behavior; Studio dependency.

Check: Get the recipient’s acceptance before changing tools
How to test: Have the actual recipient review the saved PDF and exports. Resolve every failed required check, or retain the existing tool for that part of the workflow. Keep both the original record and the test evidence.
What to record: Pass, Fail or Not applicable with a reason for each check; acceptance, reviewer and date.
